       end
   elseif method == 'LoadAnimation' and tostring(args[2]) == 'RunForward' or tostring(args[2]) == 'RunBackward' or

   elseif method == 'FireServer' and tostring(args[1]) == "ControlTurn" then

           end
       end
   end

   return oldNamecall(unpack(args))
end)
